subject: Onboarding practice loop moves a driver's peak when the person changes that detail
body: D-onboarding-015/014: when a practice answer changes a core submodality that has a Difference (same stepIndex, modality, attribute), applyChange sets difference.peak to the new value and ratingDelta to null (untested again). validateProfile accepts it, including peak == contrast. Tell me if you would rather the difference be dropped or flagged.
